rows.label: qst500702_msg0201
rows.name:
That Ardun... We were raising it, but
you defeated it.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0202
rows.name:
I'm sure you had your reasons... Maybe
you wanted an Ardun's thick horn or
a beast-smelling pelt.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0203
rows.name: No, I'm not blaming you really...

rows.label: qst500702_msg0204
rows.name:
This is a farm, we'll have plenty
more Ardun calves to raise...

rows.label: qst500702_msg0205
rows.name:
But maybe I won't ask you to help
take care of them in future.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0001
rows.name:
Wow... So you defeated
Relentless Arduran, huh?

rows.label: qst500702_msg0002
rows.name:
As long as we raise them on a farm,
we have to say goodbye someday.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0003
rows.name:
Thanks to you, it grew up splendidly,
and at the end it got to have fun
playing wildly with you.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0004
rows.name:
There shouldn't be any regrets. Not
for Relentless Arduran, me, or you.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0005
rows.name:
It'll live forever in our hearts, so
there's no need to feel sad.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0006
rows.name:
You can always see it again, so come
back and play sometime.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0101
rows.name:
Hey there! That one is
still doing just fine.

rows.label: qst500702_msg0102
rows.name:
If you have time, go play. Looks like
it can hardly wait.
